title: Reader counts, and knows where it is: count, position, advance_to

notes.author: Jack Roddy/d58bf845
notes.text: count as a free fn reads as 'count this source'; as a constructor-and-method it invites counting and then reusing a consumed reader. Leaning free fn.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/d58bf845
notes.text: Both names are nearly taken: index::count_in(path) reads a count out of an index file's header, and Index::position(name) looks a record up by name. A free index::count beside count_in, and Reader::position beside Index::position, differ in what they answer and not in what they are called.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/d58bf845
notes.text: advance_to asked to go backwards panics: the caller broke the contract, same argument as Indexable::get's invariant.
